CF_ENCMOD_ARMORED_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +2 Armor but lose 5 Speed.
CF_ENCMOD_RESISTANT_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +2 Resistance but lose 5 Speed.
CF_ENCMOD_FRENZIED_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +2 Physical Damage but lose 1 Armor.
CF_ENCMOD_SWIFT_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +10 Speed but lose 10% Max Health.
CF_ENCMOD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +10% Max Health and +1 Damage. Rewards grant +10% XP.
CF_ENCMOD_WEALTHY_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +10% Max Health but drop 25% more Gold.
CF_ENCMOD_CURSED_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +1 Resistance and may curse heroes on hit. Rewards grant +10% XP.
CF_ENCMOD_REGENERATING_DESCRIPTION: Enemies recover health at the start of their turns.
CF_ENCMOD_GLASSCANNON_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +3 Damage but lose 20% Max Health.
CF_ENCMOD_TREASUREGUARDED_DESCRIPTION: Enemies gain +15% Max Health and may yield extra loot.
